name: underground-gap-fill
title: Underground Gap Fill
author: mtopfox
description: Fills the one-tile gap after an underground pipe or belt: between two undergrounds (straight or round a corner) and, for pipes, between an underground and a machine's pipe connection. Waits until you stop drag-building, so drags keep their full underground range. Uses the item from your inventory, or a ghost when you have none. Safe to add or remove at any time.
